name: Radiation Biology
summary: How ionising radiation damages cells and organisms, from DNA breaks to cancer risk, and what that means for medicine and spaceflight.

topics.name: Types of ionising radiation and how they interact with tissue
Dose, dose equivalent and units (Gy, Sv); linear energy transfer
Direct and indirect DNA damage and free radicals
Cellular responses: repair, checkpoints and cell death
Cell survival curves and the linear-quadratic model
Relative biological effectiveness of heavy ions
Late effects: cancer risk, cataracts and cardiovascular disease
Space radiation: galactic cosmic rays, solar particle events and shielding
